units.source_text: 从喷泉右边往前走到尽头，向左拐就是儿童游乐场。

en.t: Walk straight ahead from the right side of the fountain to the end, then turn left, and there is the children's playground.

units.source_text: 频频传来孩子们的嬉戏喧闹声。

en.t: The sounds of children playing and shouting happily kept drifting over.

units.source_text: 草坪上还堆放着许多小玩意儿。

en.t: Many little playthings were also piled up on the lawn.
